$comment: Deliberate gaps in API coverage, and routes the code calls that the spec does not define.
Every entry needs a non-empty 'reason': check-api-coverage.ts rejects blank ones so this file
cannot quietly become a place to bury failures. Adding an entry is a decision, not a formality.

phantomRoutes.reason: Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 404. The spec's PUT /v1/budgets/{id}/limits/{limitId} returns 200 and is the replacement. update_budget_limit is broken until it is retargeted.

Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 404. Replacement: DELETE /v1/budgets/{id}/limits/{limitId}. delete_budget_limit is broken until it is retargeted.

Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 404 — that path exists for POST only. GET /v1/exchange-rates/{from}/{to} returns 200 and is the replacement. get_exchange_rate is broken until retargeted.

Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 404 with no parameters involved, so this is a missing route rather than a missing resource. No replacement exists; net worth must be derived from /v1/summary/basic. get_net_worth_summary should be removed.

Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 405, not 404: the collection exists for GET but not for POST. Object groups are created implicitly by setting object_group_title on a piggy bank or bill. create_object_group should be removed.

Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 405; GET on the same path returns 200. Piggy bank events are produced by transfers, not created directly. create_piggy_bank_event should be removed.

Verified absent against Firefly III 6.5.5 (API 6.5.5) on 2026-08-21 by src/tests/phantom-routes.test.ts. Returns 404. Events are not independently deletable. delete_piggy_bank_event should be removed.
